articles.title: ‘I feel like I’m cancelling out her life’: the wrenching work of clearing out a parent’s home
articles.summary: From old love letters to pieces of string, our homes are stuffed with stuff. When it comes time to empty a parent’s home, sorting the junk from the memory can be overwhelming.
body: Soon after her marriage in 1952, Ellen Rogers’ mother, Fay, bought a coordinated bedroom ensemble – a floral dressing gown and matching bedspread. The day I talk on the phone with Rogers, she has made a tough decision – she is putting the gown and bedspread in a garbage bag to be sent off to a charity shop. “I feel so bad,” she says.

Fay died in May aged 97, and had lived in the same terrace house in Camperdown in inner Sydney her whole life. Rogers grew up in the house and returned three years ago to be a live-in carer for her mother. Now she’s cleaning out the house so it can be sold. The decisions she must make are endless; which pile for what item – family, rubbish or charity? “It’s overwhelming – there’s so much,” Rogers says, “including every bloody card she ever received.”

Through winter, Rogers moved through the house alone, trying to focus on the task but not always succeeding. Her three brothers are elsewhere. “It’s quite lonely and I hate this house because it’s so cold. I just wish I could speed up the process but I can’t. Some days I’m right on to it, and then other days I just can’t, because it’s very emotional – and I’m not really an emotional person.”
points: From old love letters to pieces of string, our homes are stuffed with stuff.
When it comes time to empty a parent’s home, sorting the junk from the memory can be overwhelming.

articles.title: US fashion CEO resigns after physically restraining animal rights activists
articles.summary: Steven Kolb of the Council of Fashion Designers of America was filmed during an altercation at New York fashion week. The chief executive of the Council of Fashion Designers of America, Steven Kolb, has resigned after he was filmed physically restraining two animal rights activists during an…
body: “After 20 years leading the CFDA, I have made the difficult decision to step down as CEO and president,” Kolb said in a statement. “I am enormously proud of what we have built together and believe this is the right moment for both me and the organisation to begin a new chapter.”
Kolb had been placed on leave on Tuesday pending a review of an incident during a COS show at New York fashion week on Sunday.

In a video, Kolb could be seen trying to restrain two People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (Peta) protesters who attempted to disrupt the show in a demonstration against the use of wool by the H&M group, which owns COS.

Kolb pushed a protester, identified as Mason Melito, and covered his mouth. Kolb also wrestled a second protester to the ground, using his arms and a leg to restrain her and putting his hand over her mouth.

articles.title: The Black women who choose to have children on their own: ‘We’re going in eyes open’
articles.summary: With growing support networks online and in person, these moms say they’re changing the narrative around Black single motherhood. When Chamise Alston was ready to have a child, she connected her computer to her TV and scrolled through profiles with her best friend, dismissing people who seemed like…
body: That winter day in 2023, Alston and her friend chose a donor who would help her become pregnant with her now 16-month-old daughter. As a Black woman, she felt empowered taking control of her reproductive destiny.
“I always wanted to be a mom,” said 40-year-old Alston. “Once I realized that there was a route for me to be a mom, sans a relationship, that’s always been my mission.”

Alston is part of a growing number of Black women opting to be single moms by choice (SMBC) through IVF, intrauterine insemination and adoption. Studies show that SMBCs are most likely to be financially stable, educated women in their late 30s. While Black women who choose solo parenting fit a similar profile as their white peers, they face unique challenges. Along with navigating stigmas around Black single motherhood, they also contend with a limited number of Black and brown sperm donors, and sometimes face discriminatory experiences from hospital staff during labor and delivery.

articles.title: Don’t be afraid to be masculine, laugh more, and phone your mum: letters to our sons, by Stephen Graham, Riz Ahmed, Danny Dyer and other wise men
articles.summary: The Adolescence actor and the psychologist Orly Klein asked fathers to write to their sons. The results – from famous dads to the wisdom of strangers – were moving and motivating. Here’s a selection. What can I say?
body: What can I say? From the moment you and your sister were born my heart has been full of a love I never thought was humanly possible. As a baby you were filled with wonder and so much energy. You had a beautiful, mischievous and inquisitive nature, which has always made me smile. You were climbing, running and jumping everywhere. You’d walk into a room wearing shoes that were four times, five times, 10 times too big for you … Sometimes they were ye mother’s.

The sound of your laughter is one of the most beautiful compositions made by nature. I am so blessed to be a part of your life, and our friendship is something I hold dear to my heart. That beautiful bouncing boy has grown into a man who brightens up a room whenever he walks into it.

I have had the pleasure of watching you grow, of watching you learn the lessons of life, like how you conducted yourself when your heart was broken for the first time. To watch you navigate that pain with compassion and come out the other side appreciating your worth without holding on to any resentments, showing your vulnerability to me and your mother and allowing us to guide you through – that was truly admirable.

articles.title: Frédéric Arnault Inaugurates Loro Piana’s New Knitwear Plant
articles.summary: Vertical integration is part of a broader strategy pursued by Bernard Arnault’s son and Loro Piana’s CEO, as he seeks healthy growth and high quality.
body: With the luxury sector yet to stage a meaningful recovery, Loro Piana appears largely unfazed. On Friday, the Italian luxury brand inaugurated an 8,000-square-meter facility dedicated to knitwear, which has historically been at the heart of its business, representing an investment of several tens of millions of euros, the largest in Loro Piana’s history.

About a hundred guests, including journalists and representatives of local institutions, attended the inauguration of the Ghemme facility, located in Italy’s Piedmont region. Following a tour of the manufacturing plant, Loro Piana CEO Frédéric Arnault; Pier Luigi Loro Piana, deputy chairman of the house and sixth-generation family member; and Adolfo Urso, Italian minister of enterprises and Made in Italy, delivered speeches, followed by a ribbon-cutting ceremony. Among other attendees were Toni Belloni, president of LVMH Italy; Maria Luisa Loro Piana, the wife of the late Sergio Loro Piana, Pier Luigi’s brother, and Alberto Cirio, president of the Piedmont region.
points: Vertical integration is part of a broader strategy pursued by Bernard Arnault’s son and Loro Piana’s CEO, as he seeks healthy growth and high quality.

articles.title: Lizzy McAlpine on her New Album ‘Angel,’ Folk Fandom, and Being a Happy Homebody
articles.summary: “During the writing of this album, I started listening to a lot of Joni [Mitchell] and Nick Drake and Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young and all those artists," McAlpine says. “I think they just found me at a time when I needed them.”
body: Once you’ve started listening to Lizzy McAlpine, it’s hard to get her voice out of your head. The 26-year-old singer-songwriter started out by putting her music on SoundCloud during the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic, eventually going TikTok-viral with her 2022 single “Ceilings.” Now she’s collaborating with everyone from Noah Kahan to John Mayer and Finneas.

This week, Vogue spoke to McAlpine about the release of her folk-influenced fourth studio album, Angel; celebrating her 27th birthday and delving deep into Joni Mitchell’s back catalog; plus beginning to plan a couples costume for Halloween.

Lizzy McAlpine: Not really. It’s my birthday on Monday, and I’m having my birthday party tonight. I’m having my friends do songs from The Little Mermaid and we’re going to have costumes; we’re doing a whole thing.
This album is so heavily folk-influenced, and you made your Broadway debut in the folk musical Floyd Collins last year. How did your relationship with folk music start?
points: “During the writing of this album, I started listening to a lot of Joni [Mitchell] and Nick Drake and Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young and all those artists," McAlpine says.
“I think they just found me at a time when I needed them.”

articles.title: Tteokbokki (Spicy Korean Rice Cakes)
articles.summary: Chewy Korean rice cakes get crispy edges before simmering in a spicy, savory-sweet gochujang sauce.
body: Saucy, spicy tteokbokki stars tteok (chewy Korean rice cakes). Stir-frying the rice cakes gives them lightly crisp edges before they simmer in an umami-rich anchovy-kelp dashi spiked with gochujang and gochugaru. A generous amount of onion brings sweetness to balance the chile heat.

Bok choy isn’t traditional, but its crisp-tender texture is a welcome counterpoint to all that chew. Odeng (Korean fish cakes) adds another bouncy texture, though you can leave it out. Hard-boiled eggs round things out and are particularly good dragged through the spicy sauce.

Look for cylindrical Korean rice cakes, sometimes labeled tteok or tteokbokki tteok. This recipe calls for the approximately 2½"-long variety, cut in half on a diagonal. Look for them in the freezer section at Korean and other East Asian grocery stores. Or online at sites like Weee!

This version is quite spicy, with heat from both gochujang and gochugaru. If you’re sensitive to spice, you can omit the gochugaru (Korean chile flakes), as some readers have done successfully. Keep in mind that the heat level of gochujang (fermented chile paste) varies by brand.
points: Chewy Korean rice cakes get crispy edges before simmering in a spicy, savory-sweet gochujang sauce.
